messages.subject: Re: Inclusion of z-scores
messages.body_plain:
Hi Tabea,

Apologies for the late reply! It is definitely possible to include summary statistics that report z-scores for munge, and as you note as long as it is labelled Zscore (or any of the other names recognized by the function). The munge function automatically determines whether the GWAS reported effects are on a log odds or odds ratio scale, so no need to rename columns.

Best,
  Andrew

On Sunday, December 16, 2018 at 7:37:51 AM UTC-6, Tabea wrote:
> Dear all,
>
> I am just wondering if it is possible to include GWAS files in the munge() function that report z-scores as the effect size metric? I checked the munge function and it seems to me that I could just label the effect size column ("Zscore"), thereby it should be recognized by the function [cf. ("OR","or","B","Beta","beta","BETA","LOG_ODDS","EFFECTS","Effect_Beta","EFFECT","SIGNED_SUMSTAT", "Effect","Z","Zscore","b")] <- "effect"]? I guess that also means I would need to renames columns to indicate whether the GWAS reported effects as log odd ("LOG_ODDS") or odds ratio ("OR")?
>
> Thanks for your help!
>
> Best wishes,
> Tabea
